$comment: The rules of the docs content type (content.docs in project.json) that src/lib/docs.ts and nav.ts mirror, site/project.base.json must carry the same four rules: test/content/jx-agreement.test.ts compares them, and runs Jx's own matcher over these. The route has no /docs/ of its own: the workspace stages each project's Markdown at .generated/docs/<path>/docs/, so the id carries it.
